infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: TourGo uses your location to show nearby places on the map and to share your position with your trip group when you tap "Share my location".
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: TourGo needs access to your camera to take photos for your profile, trip expenses, and community posts.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: TourGo needs access to your photos to select and save images for your profile, trip expenses, and community posts.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: TourGo needs permission to save trip photos to your device.
